reference_sql:
WITH month_ends AS (
  -- one row per month end from December 2024 to December 2025
  SELECT CAST(range AS DATE) - 1 AS month_end
  FROM range(DATE '2025-01-01', DATE '2026-02-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
), account_mrr AS (
  -- one row per account and month end, in euros
  SELECT a.account_id, m.month_end, COALESCE(SUM(e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit), 0) AS mrr
  FROM accounts a
  CROSS JOIN month_ends m
  LEFT JOIN subscription_events e ON e.account_id = a.account_id AND e.event_date <= m.month_end
  LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
  LEFT JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY a.account_id, m.month_end
), compared AS (
  -- one row per account and month end
  SELECT account_id, month_end, mrr,
    LAG(mrr) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY month_end) AS prev_mrr
  FROM account_mrr
)
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', month_end) AS DATE) AS month_start,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN prev_mrr > 0 AND mrr > prev_mrr THEN mrr - prev_mrr ELSE 0 END), 2) AS expansion_mrr,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN mrr > 0 AND mrr < prev_mrr THEN mrr - prev_mrr ELSE 0 END), 2) AS contraction_mrr
FROM compared
WHERE month_end >= DATE '2025-01-31'
GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', month_end) AS DATE)

WITH month_ends AS (
  -- one row per month end of 2025
  SELECT CAST(range AS DATE) - 1 AS month_end
  FROM range(DATE '2025-02-01', DATE '2026-02-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
), events_eur AS (
  -- one row per subscription event, in euros
  SELECT e.account_id, e.event_date, e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit AS mrr_eur
  FROM subscription_events e
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
  JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
), pairs AS (
  -- one row per account and month end of 2025
  SELECT a.account_id, m.month_end,
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(x.mrr_eur) FROM events_eur x WHERE x.account_id = a.account_id AND x.event_date <= m.month_end), 0) AS mrr,
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(x.mrr_eur) FROM events_eur x WHERE x.account_id = a.account_id AND x.event_date < CAST(date_trunc('month', m.month_end) AS DATE)), 0) AS prev_mrr
  FROM accounts a
  CROSS JOIN month_ends m
)
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', month_end) AS DATE) AS month_start,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN prev_mrr > 0 AND mrr > prev_mrr THEN mrr - prev_mrr ELSE 0 END), 2) AS expansion_mrr,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN mrr > 0 AND mrr < prev_mrr THEN mrr - prev_mrr ELSE 0 END), 2) AS contraction_mrr
FROM pairs
GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', month_end) AS DATE)

other_way.tradeoff: Two subqueries per account and month give both balances without a window, but they scan the events twice for every pair.

solver.query:
WITH ev AS (SELECT e.account_id, a.segment, e.event_type, e.event_date, s.currency, e.mrr_delta_local AS d, e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit AS eur
  FROM subscription_events e JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = e.account_id
  JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'), me AS (SELECT last_day(CAST(t.d AS DATE)) AS me FROM generate_series(DATE '2024-12-01', DATE '2025-12-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AS t(d)),
bal AS (SELECT m.me, e.account_id, SUM(e.eur) AS mrr FROM me m JOIN ev e ON e.event_date <= m.me GROUP BY m.me, e.account_id),
w AS (SELECT account_id, me, mrr, LAG(mrr) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY me) AS prev FROM bal)
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', me) AS DATE) AS month_start,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(mrr - prev) FILTER (WHERE prev > 0 AND mrr > prev), 0), 2) AS expansion_mrr,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(mrr - prev) FILTER (WHERE prev > 0 AND mrr > 0 AND mrr < prev), 0), 2) AS contraction_mrr
FROM w WHERE me >= DATE '2025-01-31' GROUP BY 1
